name: onetouchswitch-bridge
description: Provider/partner settlement backend for onetouchswitch.com (OTS back office, never customers), built from Blockchain Lab blocks: Chainlink GBP/USD, stablecoin payout rails, OFAC payout-address screening, healthy RPC, live payout cost in GBP, payout tx verification, OTS site search. Typed JS client + MCP server + static JSON API on GitHub Pages.

scripts.test: npm run typecheck && node --test --test-concurrency=1 test/scope.test.mjs test/bridge.test.mjs test/mcp.test.mjs

author: Blockchain Lab (https://blockchainlab.com)
